title: Installation.
officialText: Air-conditioning appliances shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions. Unless the appliance is listed for installation on a combustible surface such as a floor or roof, or unless the surface is protected in an approved manner, appliances shall be installed on a surface of noncombustible construction with noncombustible material and surface finish and with no combustible material against the underside thereof.
